documented.note: FAO EcoCrop documents maize (Zea mays) as having an optimal temperature range of 18-33 degC and an optimal annual rainfall range of 600-1200 mm. These are climatic suitability parameters, not seven-day rainfall requirements or absolute survival limits.

heuristic.basis: Application-defined weekly heuristic, NOT a published requirement. 20-80 mm over 7 days is an initial application assumption for rainfall adequacy. Actual crop water requirements depend on growth stage, evapotranspiration, soil moisture and drainage.

documented.note: FAO EcoCrop documents common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) as having an optimal temperature range of 16-25 degC and an optimal annual rainfall range of 500-2000 mm. These are climatic suitability parameters, not seven-day rainfall requirements or absolute survival limits.

heuristic.basis: Application-defined weekly heuristic, NOT a published requirement. 15-60 mm over 7 days is an initial application assumption. Consider growth stage, soil moisture, rainfall distribution and the crop's sensitivity to waterlogging.

documented.note: FAO EcoCrop documents Irish potato (Solanum tuberosum) as having an optimal temperature range of 15-25 degC and an optimal annual rainfall range of 500-800 mm. These are climatic suitability parameters, not seven-day rainfall requirements or absolute survival limits.

heuristic.basis: Application-defined weekly heuristic, Not a published requirement. 20-70 m over 7 days is an initial application assumption. Consider growth stage, soil moisture and the high sensitivity of potatoes to waterlogging.

documented.note: FAO EcoCrop documents cassava (Manihot esculenta) as having an optimal temperature range of 20-29 degC and an optimal annual rainfall range of 1000-1500 mm. Cassava is drought-tolerant once established, but young plants require adequate moisture for establishment. These are climatic suitability parameters, not seven-day rainfall requirements or absolute survival limits.

heuristic.basis: Application-defined weekly heuristic, Not a published requirement. 15-60 mm over 7 days is an initital application assumption for planting establishment. Account for crop age, soil moisture, drought tolerance and drainage.
